title: Selected fixed-design reference-law benchmarks (five joint-test designs, six single-series YoY designs)
scope_statement: Selected saved designs only. Fixed-design Gaussian reference DGPs; not a calibration grid, not an estimate of the size of every arrival test, not a true-null experiment on the data. iid rows are the favourable case; the MA(11) case is the mechanical overlap of a 12-month log difference under white-noise monthly errors.
